---
name: Outline planner
description: Converts an approved source brief into a reviewable presentation outline.
---

# Outline planner

Use the source brief and relevant Markdown/TXT files. Propose, rather than
silently assume, the audience, promise, ordering, section titles, and intended
takeaway. Attach a source path to each factual section and identify unresolved
claims. This gate applies to factual authoring, not a request that only changes
the keynote's visual system or interaction behavior.

Stop after presenting the outline. Do not write public factual copy or change
publication frontmatter until a person explicitly approves the outline. If the
requested scope is ambiguous, present the smallest viable outline and list
questions.
